actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
A resident Massachusetts Drug Store pharmacy is planning operational changes. Any reporting deadlines expressly left unresolved in the notes are outside this question. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A departing MOR preserves the handover inventory in the required records while completing the proper change filings.
A retail MOR works an average of 20 hours weekly at the managed pharmacy and relies on full-time employment elsewhere.
An on-duty pharmacist leaves the prescription area unsecured because the MOR is responsible for the written security policy.
A pharmacist serves concurrently as MOR for two retail Drug Store pharmacies with nonoverlapping opening hours.

The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A manager retrospectively labels ordinary shifts as dedicated training after discovering an excessive staffing ratio.
A licensed employee assigned only to non-filling inventory duties is excluded from the ratio, with that role posted.
A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.
A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.

The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A nationally certified employee receiving dedicated training supplies the qualifying certified slot for that training assignment.
A pharmacy not providing vaccination services uses the special six-support-staff ratio based only on having three certified technicians.
A trainer and trainee are designated on the posted schedule before the training day, with written procedures in place.
A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.
One pharmacist supervises three support staff who are all ordinary technicians.

The manager is reviewing staffing assignments under Massachusetts Policy 2026-02. The stated support personnel are actively assisting prescription preparation unless the option specifies another role. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A dedicated trainer is excluded while independently filling prescriptions between trainee demonstrations.
A pharmacist preceptor directly supervises four interns during an exclusively immunization clinic.
One pharmacist supervises three support staff including one licensed intern and two ordinary technicians.
A domestic pharmacy student receives a Massachusetts intern license before beginning a hospital internship.
An employee scheduled exclusively for computer training is excluded while doing no professional support work.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
Case A: One pharmacist is scheduled with four prescription-filling support personnel: one certified technician, one intern, and two ordinary technicians.

Case B: The scheduler substitutes an ordinary technician for the intern, leaving one certified technician and three ordinary technicians in the four-person group.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The one-to-four rule requires an intern even when two certified technicians are present.
Any single certified technician qualifies a four-person support group.
The first group satisfies a listed one-to-four qualifying-category combination.
A compliant one-to-four ratio permits ordinary technicians to perform final verification.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
Case A: One pharmacist is scheduled with four prescription-filling support personnel: one certified technician, one intern, and two ordinary technicians.

Case B: The scheduler substitutes an ordinary technician for the intern, leaving one certified technician and three ordinary technicians in the four-person group.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A compliant one-to-four ratio permits ordinary technicians to perform final verification.
The first group satisfies a listed one-to-four qualifying-category combination.
One certified technician with three ordinary technicians does not satisfy the stated one-to-four combinations.
Two certified technicians can satisfy the qualifying component of a four-person group.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee is performing data-entry work while a pharmacist is directly supervising the trainee. At pickup, the patient asks whether the new medication can be taken with warfarin, and the profile shows an unresolved DUR alert. Which actions are appropriate for the trainee? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Collect and enter nonclinical demographic information while remaining under direct pharmacist supervision.
Counsel the patient on the interaction after reading the drug-information screen.
Perform authorized prescription-processing and staging tasks under direct pharmacist supervision, while leaving final verification to the pharmacist.
Continue other authorized clerical or technical trainee functions while under direct pharmacist supervision.
Refer the clinical question and unresolved DUR issue to the pharmacist rather than exercising pharmacist professional judgment.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is assigning staff to receive Schedule II stock. The pharmacist has approved written policies and procedures. Which statements correctly distinguish the current technician pathways? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A registered pharmacy technician may assist with transporting Schedule II stock under pharmacist supervision.
A registered pharmacy technician who is not certified may assist with Schedule II transport under pharmacist supervision but does not thereby gain the certified technician's broader handling role.
A certified pharmacy technician may assist with transporting and handling Schedule II stock under pharmacist supervision when the pharmacy's approved policies permit it.
A pharmacy technician trainee may independently assume Schedule II accountability because trainee registration is enough to replace pharmacist oversight.
The pharmacist remains responsible for Schedule II accountability, security, and professional judgment even when authorized support personnel assist.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A pharmacy schedules an intern for a shift without a pharmacist preceptor directing the work. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A senior technician may serve as the preceptor.
The intern must work under direct supervision of a registered pharmacist preceptor.
Five hundred internship hours permit independent prescription verification.
Intern status does not authorize independent pharmacist practice.
The pharmacist preceptor remains responsible for the supervision relationship.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A patient asks Pharmacy B to obtain a Massachusetts warfarin prescription from Pharmacy A. The prescription was issued 10 months ago and has three authorized refills remaining. Pharmacy B has a certified pharmacy technician available, and the pharmacist on duty approves the technician’s participation. Which statements are consistent with the current Massachusetts transfer framework? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacies should act on the patient’s transfer request in a timely manner rather than impose a blanket no-transfer rule.

A Schedule VI prescription may be transferred in the same manner as Schedule III-V prescriptions, and the remaining authorized refills may be transferred while the prescription is within the one-year limit.
A certified pharmacy technician may perform a Schedule VI prescription transfer when the pharmacist on duty approves the activity.
Massachusetts requires the transferring pharmacy to charge the patient a transfer fee before releasing the prescription.
The transfer is barred solely because the prescription is more than six months old, even though it was issued less than one year ago.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts drug store pharmacy holds its ordinary pharmacy license but has never obtained a sterile compounding pharmacy license. It wants to begin preparing patient-specific sterile ophthalmic preparations on site. Which statement best describes the licensure issue?

choices.text: The ordinary drug store license is sufficient whenever each preparation is patient-specific.
The pharmacy may begin immediately and seek a sterile-compounding license only if the Board later inspects it.
The pharmacy needs the applicable sterile compounding pharmacy licensure before engaging in this sterile compounding activity.
Sterile compounding is permitted without additional licensure when no Schedule II-V drug is used.
Sterile compounding licensure applies only to out-of-state pharmacies shipping into Massachusetts.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy completed its routine annual self-inspection three months ago. It now relocates to a new address, and a Board inspector arrives without prior notice shortly afterward. Which statements are accurate? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The relocation triggers another Board-tool self-inspection within the regulatory timeframe even though the annual self-inspection was recent.
The Board may inspect the licensed pharmacy without prior notice.
The pharmacy may decline to provide requested pharmacy records because the inspection was unannounced.
The recent annual self-inspection prevents another self-inspection from being required during the same calendar year.
The pharmacy should provide documents requested by the Board or its designee in connection with the inspection.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist preceptor is already directly supervising two pharmacy interns on the same shift. The pharmacy manager asks the preceptor to take on a third intern for that shift, noting that the pharmacy is well under its overall support-personnel ratio. How should the preceptor respond?

choices.text: Accept, because the overall support-personnel ratio is the only applicable limit.
Accept, provided the third intern has already completed 1000 internship hours.
Accept, provided the third intern works only on non-dispensing tasks.
Decline, because a preceptor may supervise interns only in a teaching hospital.
Decline, because a preceptor may not directly supervise more than two interns at one time.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is scheduling a shift and wants to work with four support personnel assisting in filling prescriptions. Which staffing combinations satisfy the minimum supervisory ratio? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One certified pharmacy technician, one pharmacy intern and two pharmacy technicians.
Two certified pharmacy technicians and two pharmacy technician trainees.
One pharmacy intern, one pharmacy technician and two pharmacy technician trainees.
Four pharmacy technicians whose licences are all current.
One certified pharmacy technician and three pharmacy technician trainees.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is working with three support personnel who satisfy the applicable supervisory ratio. A cashier who rings up front-store sales and never assists with prescriptions is also on duty. The Manager of Record asks whether the cashier pushes the pharmacist over the ratio. What is the correct analysis?

choices.text: The cashier is excluded from the ratio because they do not support the pharmacist in a professional capacity.
The cashier counts as a fourth support person and the ratio is exceeded.
The cashier counts unless the pharmacy documents a written exemption.
The cashier counts only during hours when the pharmacy department is open.
The cashier counts as half of a support person for ratio purposes.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: An applicant for a Massachusetts pharmacy technician licence is 19, holds a high school diploma, is of good moral character and has no drug-related felony. Which of the following, standing alone, satisfies the remaining eligibility requirement? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Certification conferred by a Board-approved certifying body.
A substantially equivalent pharmacy technician licence in good standing in another state.
A Board-approved passing score on a Board-approved assessment examination taken after completing a Board-approved training program.
Twelve months of employment as a pharmacy cashier in a licensed pharmacy.
A letter from the employing Manager of Record attesting to the applicant's competence.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts preceptor is reviewing a candidate's internship record against the Board-approved internship requirement. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One pathway requires at least 1500 hours, of which at least 1000 are in a Board-approved pharmacy or pharmacy-related setting.
On that pathway at least 500 hours must be in clinical pharmacy, a demonstration project, manufacturing, or analytical or industrial pharmacy.
An alternative pathway is at least 1500 intern hours acquired through experiential pharmacy education for a graduate of an ACPE-accredited institution.
The Board may grant credit for out-of-state internship experience on appropriate documentation.
All 1500 hours must be acquired within a single calendar year.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist properly worked fourteen hours yesterday under a documented extenuating circumstance. Since finishing she has rested four hours, worked a short shift in an unrelated setting, and then rested a further five hours. She now proposes to resume work in a pharmacy. What does the regulation require of her?

choices.text: Nothing further, since she has now rested nine hours in total since that shift.
An eight consecutive hour rest period before she resumes work in a pharmacy.
A twenty-four hour break, because the previous shift exceeded twelve hours.
Notification to the Board before she returns to practice in any pharmacy.
Nothing further, because the extenuating circumstance was properly documented.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is being sold. Twenty days before the closing date the buyer submits a complete licence application with the controlled substance inventory report and the bill of sale. The seller files nothing, on the basis that the buyer's application tells the Board everything it needs. Is the seller's position sound?

choices.text: No, because the outgoing licensee owes the Board its own notice of the transfer.
No, because the seller must instead surrender the licence to the Board first.
Yes, because the buyer's application was filed more than 14 days ahead.
Yes, because the inventory report identifies both pharmacies to the Board.
Yes, provided the seller countersigns the buyer's licence application.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem: One Massachusetts pharmacist is supervising one certified pharmacy technician and two pharmacy technicians. Another employee holds a current pharmacy technician license but is assigned only to the front register and initially performs no professional pharmacy support. During a rush, the manager directs that employee to enter prescription data. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: While the employee performs only cashier duties and no professional pharmacy support, the employee may be excluded from the support-personnel ratio.
Once the employee begins prescription data entry, the cashier label no longer keeps the employee outside the ratio.
The resulting four-person support team is permitted because every member holds a pharmacy personnel credential.
The employee remains excluded for the entire shift because the schedule lists the employee as a cashier.
The data-entry assignment must satisfy technician scope and supervision rules independently of the numerical ratio analysis.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
Two resident retail Drug Store pharmacies have nonoverlapping opening hours. One pharmacist would work 32 hours weekly at each and proposes to be MOR at both.

What prevents approval of this arrangement under the general retail MOR rule? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Concurrent MOR appointments at two retail pharmacies are prohibited.
The pharmacist must average at least 40 hours at each pharmacy.
Both pharmacies must first share a real-time prescription database.
One pharmacy must change from resident to nonresident status.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
A pharmacist with an active Massachusetts pharmacist license rents a storefront for a new retail pharmacy. The facility's Drug Store Pharmacy application is pending. Until approval, the pharmacist proposes dispensing commercially manufactured Schedule VI prescriptions without performing any compounding.

How should the pharmacist assess this proposed start of dispensing? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Begin under the active personal pharmacist license because the proposed stock contains no federally scheduled controlled substances.
Begin after the pharmacist accepts MOR responsibility because that designation supplies the pending facility authorization.
Obtain the required Drug Store Pharmacy license before dispensing these prescriptions, despite the active personal pharmacist license.
Begin with manufacturer-sealed packages because handling finished products does not require the pharmacy license used for compounding.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
The Board approved a Massachusetts pharmacy's initial application fourteen months ago. Construction delays prevented the pharmacy from opening, and it has never dispensed a prescription. The facility license has not reached its printed expiration date. The manager now schedules the first day of business but has obtained no written permission for the delayed opening.

What must the manager resolve before the pharmacy first opens? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Proceed under the original approval because an unexpired facility license makes the opening date immaterial.
Obtain the Board's written permission to open more than one calendar year after its application approval.
File a new application because the Board cannot permit an opening after the one-year period.
Use the date the pharmacy first receives medication stock to start the one-year opening period.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
An out-of-state pharmacy is preparing its first Massachusetts nonresident Drug Store Pharmacy application. Its home-state license is active. The application includes home-state proof of good standing dated two months before submission and a report from a Board-approved inspector whose inspection occurred thirty months before submission. The other required application components are complete.

Which document update is required under the stated nonresident application benchmarks? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Replace both documents because the good-standing proof and inspection report must each be less than three months old.
Update the good-standing proof, but retain the inspection report because it was completed within the license-renewal cycle.
Keep both documents because active home-state licensure is sufficient to establish their continued validity for Massachusetts.
Keep the two-month-old good-standing proof and obtain a Board-approved inspection report from within the preceding two years.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
A pharmacy assigns a Massachusetts-licensed technician solely to an inventory project: recording expiration dates on unopened Schedule VI stock. The technician performs no prescription preparation or filling, and the filling team separately meets its supervisory ratio. The posted schedule lists the technician's name and shift but no assigned role; the MOR has put the inventory assignment only in a private personnel file.

Which schedule change supports excluding this technician from the filling-support ratio under Board policy? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Remove the technician's name from the posted schedule because the worker is outside the ratio.
Keep the role only in the personnel file because the posted schedule already identifies the technician.
Add 'excluded from ratio' beside the name without identifying the assigned duties.
Add the stock-inventory assignment beside the technician's name on the posted schedule.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
A licensed intern is preparing prescriptions in a Massachusetts retail pharmacy when the usual preceptor must leave. A second registered pharmacist preceptor is on site and available, but is unaware of the intern's current assignments and is not observing or directing that work. The departing preceptor offers to remain available by telephone.

What should the pharmacist arrange before the intern continues after the departure? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Keep the usual preceptor responsible by telephone and have a certified technician direct the intern on site.
Continue the assignment based on the second preceptor's presence in the pharmacy.
Have the second preceptor take over direct observation and direction of the intern's work.
Require the usual preceptor to return because a replacement preceptor cannot supervise this internship.

actual_nearest_originals_for_direct_read.stem:
A retail store has scheduled a Massachusetts-licensed pharmacy technician trainee for computer training from 8:00 to 9:00 a.m., before the pharmacy's posted opening time. The required trainee designation and Computer Training period were placed on the schedule the previous day. Training uses simulation modules in a staff room outside the separately locked and alarmed prescription department. The trainee has no access to that department, medications, live prescriptions, or patient information and performs no pharmacy support. No pharmacist or dedicated trainer is present during that hour.

May the scheduled training proceed under these conditions? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: It must wait for an on-site pharmacist because the employee is training under a technician-trainee license.
It may proceed if a pharmacist stays on a video call, because computer training requires continuous remote supervision.
It may proceed without supervision only after the employee obtains a full technician license rather than a trainee license.
It may proceed without a supervisor for that scheduled period while the trainee remains exclusively on the modules.
